name: Discern Spirit Presence
body:
School divination; Level cleric/oracle 1, druid 1, inquisitor 1, ranger 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, DF

EFFECT

Range 60 feet

Area cone-shaped emanation

Duration concentration, up to 1 minute/level

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell allows you to discern the presence of spirits (fey, outsiders, and incorporeal undead) within the area of effect. You do not learn the location, type, power, or aura of any detected spirits, merely the fact that they do exist in the affected area. You can detect a spirit’s presence even if they are polymorphed, possessing a creature or object, or manifesting in some way (such as a curse), but if they have an ability or feat that would allow them a chance to avoid detection, they can still do so.

Each round, you may turn to discern the presence of spirits in a new area. Because this spell is focused on spirits and not the material world, it is only blocked by barriers made of materials that are harmful to spirits or summoned by magic.
